N5 [Nit] review-a: Lessons 5 and 6 (lessons-learned.md:45-46) and human gates 4 and 5 (tech-debt.md:90-91) have no run-log source in this track. They are consistent with the evidence: the Green P2 logs carry bare dispositions lines such as 'B6=DECLINE', plan.md:92 records the r7 role base repair, and 9256a77b is not an ancestor of origin/master. Add a source pointer at closeout.
